name: HTML deck viewer navigates slides, presents fullscreen and exports PNG
description: In the generated-deck viewer, arrow navigation updates the slide counter, Present opens fullscreen and PNG export saves the current slide.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the app root URL / and click the 'Template studio — HTML decks' mode switch tab.

Keep the default/first available template selected (or click any template card if none is selected), type the brief 'Team offsite agenda for a 20-person design team: schedule, workshops, logistics' and click the generate button.
Wait for the deck viewer to open with the finished deck (allow up to 180 seconds) and note the total slide count shown in the slide counter.
Click the next-slide control (or press the ArrowRight key) twice.
Verify the slide counter advanced (e.g. from '01 / N' to '03 / N') and the visible slide content changed.
Verify the deck enters fullscreen presentation mode (the stage fills the screen; an Escape hint may appear).
Press the Escape key to exit presentation mode.
Verify the viewer returns to the normal view with the toolbar visible again.
Verify a success toast like 'Slide PNG saved.' appears and no error toast appears (allow up to 60 seconds for the snapshot).
